title.narrative: Intensifying agricultural production through cash transfer interventions among farming households severely impacted by El Nino in Malawi.

description.narrative: The main goal of this project is to provide food-security assistance via providing one-off, unconditional cash transfers coupled with awareness and sensitization sessions to intensify agricultural production. These activities will be implemented to support 3,950 households (approximately 17,775 people) in Machinga, encouraging them to protect productive agricultural assets and sustain their agricultural outputs in the face of El Niño. Under the Food Security- Agriculture sector, this project will target 17,775 people including 8,710 women, 5,333 children, and 1,715 persons with disabilities.
